Global (All).title: US Senate Passes Bill to Support Ukraine
Global (All).summary: The US Senate has passed a bill to provide $40 billion in support to Ukraine, amid ongoing tensions with Russia.

Global (All).title: North Korea Fires Multiple Ballistic Missiles
Global (All).summary: North Korea has fired multiple ballistic missiles into the sea, prompting a warning from South Korea and Japan.

Global (All).title: Global Fintech Firm Hit by Cyber Attack
Global (All).summary: A global fintech firm has been hit by a major cyber attack, potentially exposing sensitive customer data.

United States.title: US-Mexico border sees influx of migrants after Mexico's president visits White House
United States.summary: Mexico's president visited the White House in a bid to strengthen trade ties and address migration concerns. The visit comes as thousands of migrants, mostly from Cuba, Nicaragua and Venezuela, arrive at the US-Mexico border, putting a strain on resources and sparking controversy over immigration policies.

United States.title: Former Donald Trump aides charged with 'conspiracy to corruptly solicit, accept and falsify presidential campaign contributions'
United States.summary: The US Department of Justice announced charges against several former Donald Trump aides in connection with an investigation into their alleged efforts to solicit and accept unlawful campaign contributions from foreign nationals.

United States.title: US Supreme Court blocks House committee's subpoena of Trump's tax returns
United States.summary: The US Supreme Court temporarily blocked a House committee's subpoena of former President Donald Trump's tax returns, pending review by a federal appeals court. The decision comes as part of an ongoing battle over access to Trump's financial records.

South Korea.title: Concerns over North Korea's COVID-19 lockdown easing and its implications for South Korea's security
South Korea.summary: North Korea's easing of its COVID-19 lockdown has raised concerns about the potential spread of the virus to South Korea, posing a significant security risk to the region.

South Korea.title: South Korea's response to North Korea's missile tests
South Korea.summary: South Korea has responded to North Korea's recent missile tests, highlighting the ongoing tensions between the two nations and the need for a coordinated response.

South Korea.title: Protests in South Korea over pension reform
South Korea.summary: Protests have broken out in South Korea over proposed pension reform, with demonstrators expressing concerns about the impact on their retirement benefits and the overall stability of the pension system.
